ana_partnerops: quick vendor update: nvidia reported an H100 microcode anomaly that inflates tail latency for long-context inference. they propose a patch but want a 48h canary soak on our images before public listing. asking if we can gate marketplace + push public announce ~10 days.

lei_hw: confirmed isolated to H100 path. h200/b200, mi300, gaudi unaffected. lab will run canary tonight. checklist: build canary, deploy us+eu, 48h soak, capture tail traces. ETA ~48-60h.

sam_platform: we can add a temporary routing rule to fallback pinned workloads to mi300-q8 for non-critical jobs. need sales/legal signoff for reserved pools.

maria_pm: marketing: hold creative and ad buys pending final signoff. can do si-only access if vendor agrees.

simon_sales: i'll flag top reserved accounts and prepare customer templates. prefer staged SI access to avoid blocking integrations.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: marketplace/canary-image -> staging at 2026-05-18T02:58Z (CI #79012).

ana_partnerops: vendor ok with SI-gated rollout. i'll book vendor+redwood reconvene in 72h and keep this thread as single source. short status-only updates please.
